export_note: Field-selected historical receipts. Device alias, host and compiler build identifiers are omitted; compute capability, capacity and software versions are retained. GPU operator and transfer cases use cuda:0; the container case runs on CPU. All timing observations and summaries are unchanged. Transfer setup, memory and source hash were restored from the original receipt. Original source hashes are retained; at the r5 export, shipped execution scripts differed only in the --allow-non-rtx help text, which used a generic device description. In r6, rtx_dit_lab.py additionally enforces fixed-fixture Attention numerical tolerances and treats an unavailable Flash backend as skipped, not technically passed. The r6 script has not been rerun on a GPU; historical source hashes and all measured values remain unchanged.
